name: Mascara
description: TSA rules for flying with mascara, liquid eyeliner, and cosmetic products in carry-on and checked luggage.

carryOn.reason: Mascara is classified as a liquid/gel by the TSA and is subject to the 3-1-1 liquids rule in carry-on baggage. The tube must be 3.4 oz (100ml) or less and fit inside your quart-sized clear plastic liquids bag.
conditions: Must be in a container of 3.4 oz (100ml) or less (almost all commercial mascara tubes are 0.2 to 0.4 oz, so standard tubes easily comply).
Must fit inside your single quart-sized clear zip-top liquids bag alongside other toiletries.
exceptions: Solid powder eyeshadow, dry blushes, and pencil eyeliners are exempt from the liquids bag rule.

checkedBag.reason: Mascara and all makeup cosmetics are fully allowed in checked baggage without size or quantity restrictions.
conditions: Ensure caps are tightened to avoid leaks from aircraft cargo hold pressure changes.

tsa.pageTitle: Can I bring mascara on a plane?

airlines.name: Air France
airlines.notes: Mascara counts toward the 1-liter plastic bag of 100ml liquids for cabin luggage.

airlines.name: British Airways
airlines.notes: Liquid cosmetics including mascara must be in containers of 100ml or less.

travelTips: Virtually every standard mascara tube is under 0.5 oz (15ml), so it complies with the 3.4 oz size limit — but remember it must go into your clear liquids bag.
Switching to waterproof pencil eyeliners and powder eye products frees up valuable space in your quart-sized liquids bag.
Pack a travel makeup bag in your carry-on for quick touch-ups after long-haul flights.

faq.question: Is mascara considered a liquid by TSA?
faq.answer: Yes! The TSA and international airport security authorities classify mascara, liquid eyeliner, lip gloss, and concealer as liquids/gels. They must be packed inside your quart-sized clear 3-1-1 liquids bag.

faq.question: Do I have to take mascara out of my bag at TSA security?
faq.answer: Yes, if you are going through a standard TSA security lane, your quart-sized liquids bag (which includes your mascara) must be placed in a bin for X-ray screening. TSA PreCheck travelers may leave it inside their bag.

faq.question: Can I pack full-size makeup in my checked bag?
faq.answer: Yes! All makeup, liquids, foundations, perfumes, and mascaras are 100% permitted in checked suitcases in any quantity or container size.
